title: Leyline terrain delta, Leyline's own form (the Den's ground file)
description: The form leyline-terrain keeps as the Den's ground (<dens>/yourden.terrain.json, written by the launcher, read by Den Lite and by every launcher that rebuilds the tile). Same format name and version as docs/terrain-delta.schema.json (Forge's form, which the crate also reads and writes: leyline_terrain::flat); this one adds what Forge's form can't carry yet: the tile's map folder, removing models (models is the complete list), more than one water layer and per-vertex water, a WMO's bounds and doodad set, ground effects, and chunks that list only what changed. To reconcile into one schema: owner's call. A Den's ground as numbers and file names only (docs/NOGGIT-DEN-PLAN.md 2.5). Each player's launcher rebuilds the map tile from their OWN game files plus this file (leyline-terrain apply); the file never holds a byte of a game file. Read by a strict parser (unknown keys refused), never run, at most 4 MB. Written by leyline-terrain diff (the launcher, after Forge closes) and by Forge. Base64 is standard (RFC 4648, with padding). Chunk index i = row * 16 + column (the order of the tile's chunk table; row = the chunk's IndexY, column = its IndexX). A chunk that is the same as the base is left out; a key left out of a chunk means 'as the base'.

base.description: What the tile is made from: 'own' = the tile from the player's own game files (the default); 'blank' = a flat empty tile made by leyline-terrain; 'pack:<id>' = a pack's land (later).

tile.description: Which map tile: the map's id, its folder name under World/Maps, and the two numbers of the tile's file name in order (<dir>_<x>_<y>.adt). The Den is map 1, dir Kalimdor, x 1, y 1.

open.description: The chunks that may differ from the base (0-255). apply refuses a delta whose chunks lie outside this list. The Den's white pad is 4 chunks; each 'Make the Den bigger' adds a ring.

pad.description: How the white pad was made (kept for the next ring): its floor height in world yards and its texture.

centre.description: world x, y the pad grows around

origin.description: World x, y, z that model positions are relative to (the Den's middle, so a template can move). Default [0, 0, 0]: positions are world coordinates.

models.description: When present: the tile's COMPLETE list of placed models (it replaces the base's doodads and buildings). Left out: as the base.

path.description: A file name inside the game's archives, backslashes or slashes, no '..', no drive.

xy.description: The chunk's corner in world x, y (its highest x and y; the chunk spans 33.333 yards towards lower x and y). Informational, for readers without the base tile (Den Lite).

heights.description: 145 x float32 little-endian, ABSOLUTE world heights, in the tile's vertex order: 9 outer, 8 inner, ... 9 outer (17 rows). Row r of outer vertices lies r * 4.1667 yards towards lower x from the corner, column c towards lower y; inner ones half a step further each way.

layers.description: The chunk's texture layers, bottom first, 1 to 4. 'alpha' (64 x 64 uint8, row by row, 0 = none, 255 = full) is required for every layer after the first and not allowed on the first.

flags.description: layer flags without the alpha bits (0x100, 0x200): rotation/animation bits

holes.description: 4 x 4 hole bits, bit (row * 4 + column), 1 = hole

colors.description: 145 x 4 bytes of vertex shading (as the tile's own), or null to remove

water.description: The chunk's water: null = none. Otherwise its layers.

type.description: liquid type id (1 water, 2 ocean, 3 magma, 4 slime, ...: the player's own liquid table)

mask.description: w*h bits, row by row, low bit first; left out = every cell

path.description: an .m2 (a doodad) or .wmo (a building) in the player's own archives

uid.description: unique id; models Leyline adds use 0x7F000000 and up

pos.description: world x, y, z minus origin

rot.description: degrees, as the tile stores them

bounds.description: .wmo only: world min x, y, z, max x, y, z minus origin
